title: When Your Reviewer is an LLM: Biases, Divergence, and Prompt Injection Risks in Peer Review
reasoning: The paper includes 'Rigor of Ethical Evaluation' as one of eight evaluation themes to test LLM review capabilities, focusing on how models identify fairness and privacy issues in submitted research. however, this is a minor component of a broader performance benchmark for the peer review process, not a dedicated evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical systems.
